title: Find the Longest Equal Subarray
summary: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, find the longest subarray where all elements are equal after removing at most k elements.
statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, find the longest subarray where all elements are equal after removing at most k elements. An equal subarray has identical elements, including the empty subarray.
constraints: nums is nonempty and k is nonnegative.
Delete at most k values; the answer is the longest contiguous equal block in the remaining array.
Return the number of retained equal values, not the original window width.
hints: A window is usable when its non-majority elements can all be deleted.
Track value frequencies and the largest frequency while advancing a sliding window.
Shrink when window_length-most_frequency exceeds k; return the largest retained frequency.
Any feasible equal result corresponds to a window whose other values are deleted, and the window invariant retains every candidate capable of improving the best frequency.
editorial: Any feasible equal result corresponds to a window whose other values are deleted, and the window invariant retains every candidate capable of improving the best frequency.

tests.explanation: Deleting two intervening values joins the three occurrences of three.
Deleting both twos joins four ones into the longest equal block.
